newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Trump Hotels cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Trump Hotels cut to hold.

text.p: -- Salomon Bros gaming analyst Bruce Turner said in a research note that he lowered his recommendation on Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc to hold from buy, a moved based on a review of the company's third quarter 10-Q filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that revealed a one-time $5 million gain in Trump Plaza's $30.6 million third quarter EBITDA.

-- The analyst said in the note the downgrade also was based on the termination of discussions with Rank Organisation Plc regarding Rank investing in the Trump Castle to renovate it into a Hard Rock Hotel and Casino.
